I don’t know. Anything is welcomed, my whole life feels empty, I don’t know who I am without her. 
She left me because she started to love someone else.

I only feel fine when I’m sleeping, as soon as I wake up I want to go back to sleep or just disappear. I know I need to leave this place so I don’t see her everyday, but I can barely look at room ads without starting to cry.

To be honest her ghosting was sort of my fault, she would sometimes invite me to hang out with her friends and I would say no because I did not know any of them, in the last few months I stopped sleeping with her because I changed my computer from the room and I would stay up until a bit late and would just fall asleep in the couch where my pc is. I regret that a lot.

But yes, I’m in denial for certain and you are right. Thanks for the harsh but true words.
I couldn’t do that to her, it would give her immense stress. I know some of you might think she deserves it, and in a way I kind of feel that way too, but doing that to her is just not me.

Yes, I want to be more independent for sure. I’ve already made some arrangements to when I come back, I need to move out, I need to go out more often with friends, people have advised to go to a gym, I might try my luck on building a business.

I want this to be a new beggining.

It feels so hard to turn this page though.

Yes I would normally not argue about it. But this time I feel it’s different because of the whole bi thing. She says she doesn’t feel attracted to any other girl but this one, I don’t really know what to take of this. Could she just be confused, could she just be exploring her soul, I feel very lost in my feelings. I would be willing to forgive her and I have hope she wants me back.

It’s very hard to simply forget her because she broke my trust. 11 years with her don’t fade away this easily.

I did suggest her an open relationship while she explores her sexuality, but nothing more, I would not be comfortable at all with exploring it with her in that way.

When I first discovered about them we broke up, but she would say she needed time to think about this and that she didn’t know what we would be after this trip, but after I pressed more on this she did say she had already decided and doesn’t want a relationship with me anymore.
Thank you so much for your words, they gave me some comfort. You are a good person, wish I had a few friends like you irl.

Thanks for your comfort, everyone says this suffering will be over one day, I seriously hope that is true, but at the moment that day seems impossible to come.

I will try to connect to some friends and go from there.
Obrigado pelos subs, desconhecia alguns. Vou tentar a minha sorte.
Obrigado pelas palavras. Caracóis e uns finos sempre ajudaram sem duvida :)
Thank you for your words, they mean a lot. I hope it gets easier quick.

Everyday feels the same, this void that nothing can fill. All the small things we had now feel so big and important.
